attractions.name: Baga Beach
attractions.description: One of Goa's most famous and vibrant beaches, known for its water sports, shacks, and lively nightlife. A must-visit for first-timers.

attractions.name: Basilica of Bom Jesus
attractions.description: A UNESCO World Heritage Site housing the mortal remains of St. Francis Xavier. One of the finest examples of baroque architecture in India.

attractions.name: Dudhsagar Waterfalls
attractions.description: One of India's tallest waterfalls at 310 meters. Located on the Mandovi River at the Goa–Karnataka border. Best visited post-monsoon.
attractions.address: Bhagwan Mahavir Wildlife Sanctuary, Mollem, Goa 403410

attractions.name: Anjuna Flea Market
attractions.description: The iconic Wednesday flea market in Anjuna beach. A kaleidoscope of local crafts, clothing, spices, and Goan trinkets.

attractions.name: Fort Aguada
attractions.description: A 17th-century Portuguese fort overlooking the Arabian Sea. Features a four-storey lighthouse and offers spectacular sunset views.
attractions.address: Fort Aguada Rd, Sinquerim, North Goa, Goa 403519

attractions.name: Calangute Beach
attractions.description: Known as the 'Queen of Beaches', Calangute is the largest beach in North Goa, offering parasailing, jet skiing, and banana boat rides.

attractions.name: Palolem Beach
attractions.description: A crescent-shaped beach in South Goa, considered one of India's most beautiful. Perfect for swimming, kayaking, and silent disco nights.

attractions.name: Chapora Fort
attractions.description: Famous for its panoramic views of Vagator Beach and the Arabian Sea. Immortalized by the Bollywood film Dil Chahta Hai.
